nodes.body: Proposed fix: https://github.com/rhaiscript/rhai/pull/1189. It has two commits: the restore-on-unwind fix for the abort, and a separate one for the `sync` panic behind it (`is_locked` under `sync`), which changes a documented method and is left for you to shape.

nodes.title: A panic inside a native function called with a variable first argument aborts the process (ArgBackup::drop asserts during unwinding)
